Definition: Mean daily kWh
Standard deviation of daily kWh divided by its mean
Variance of the change between consecutive half-hourly readings
Correlation of each half-hourly reading with the same half-hour on the previous day
98th percentile of half-hourly kWh divided by the median (plus 0.001 kWh)
Share of kWh used 00:00–07:00
Share of kWh used 06:00–09:00
Share of kWh used 16:00–20:00
Share of kWh used 20:00–24:00
Mean weekend daily kWh divided by mean weekday daily kWh
99th percentile of half-hourly kWh
Share of kWh in half-hours above 1.25 kWh (2.5 kW)
Longest run of half-hours above 1.25 kWh in a day, mean of the 3 highest days
Largest rise between consecutive half-hours in a day, mean of the 3 highest days
Mean of a day's half-hours above 1.25 kWh divided by their maximum (0 when none), mean of the 3 highest days
Share of weekdays with a suspected charging event
Share of weekend days with a suspected charging event
Energy above the reference profile inside events, per week
Median over event days of the day's longest event, in hours
How tightly event start times cluster at one time of day (0 = spread out, 1 = always the same half-hour)
